017package org.apache.juneau.console.bus;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.io.*;
022
023import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.http.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.marshall.collections.*;
027import org.apache.juneau.marshall.json.*;
028import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.*;

030/**
031 * Exposes the bus's session POST and SSE stream on a REST resource.
032 *
033 * <ul>
034 *    <li><b>{@code POST <servlet>/juneau-bus/session}</b> &mdash; opens a session and returns its grant.  This is the
035 *       protocol's only state-changing request, so every guard the application has applies to it.
036 *    <li><b>{@code GET <servlet>/juneau-bus/stream/{sessionId}}</b> &mdash; a held-open {@code text/event-stream} of bus
037 *       frames, each as {@code event: bus}.  Gated by the capability in the path; an unknown or expired id, or another
038 *       principal, is a {@code 404}.
039 * </ul>
040 *
041 * <p>
042 * When {@link BusPolicy#boundary()} is set, both endpoints run its {@code check}: the full write check on the POST,
043 * and on the GET whatever the boundary applies to a read (a {@code LoopbackBoundary}'s Host check, a
044 * {@code CsrfBoundary}'s allowed hosts).  The method judged is the one the request claims, so a GET carrying a
045 * {@code method} parameter or an override header that claims a write gets the write check.
046 *
047 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
048 * <p class='bjava'>
049 *   <ja>@Rest</ja>(path=<js>"/ops/jobs"</js>)
050 *   <jk>public class</jk> JobsRest <jk>extends</jk> BasicRestServlet <jk>implements</jk> AsyncJobsMixin, BusEventsMixin {
051 *     <jk>static final</jk> ServerBus <jsf>BUS</jsf> = ServerBus.<jsm>create</jsm>(BusPolicy.<jsm>create</jsm>()
052 *       .downstream(<js>"ops.jobs"</js>, <jk>true</jk>).build());
053 *     <ja>@Override</ja> <jk>public</jk> ServerBus serverBus() { <jk>return</jk> <jsf>BUS</jsf>; }
054 *     ...
055 *   }
056 * </p>
057 *
058 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
059 * <p class='bjava'>
060 *   <jc>// An application with its own request-token guard puts it in front of the session POST.
061 *   // Re-declaring @RestPost here is optional and registers the route once.</jc>
062 *   <ja>@Override</ja> <ja>@RestPost</ja>(path=<jsf>SESSION_PATH</jsf>)
063 *   <jk>public</jk> JsonMap openBusSession(RestRequest <jv>req</jv>, RestResponse <jv>res</jv>) {
064 *     requireCsrfToken(<jv>req</jv>);
065 *     <jk>return</jk> BusEventsMixin.<jk>super</jk>.openBusSession(<jv>req</jv>, <jv>res</jv>);
066 *   }
067 * </p>
068 *
069 * @since 10.0.0
070 */
071public interface BusEventsMixin {
072
073   /** The servlet-relative prefix of both endpoints. */
074   String BUS_PREFIX = "/juneau-bus";
075
076   /** The session POST path. */
077   String SESSION_PATH = BUS_PREFIX + "/session";
078
079   /** The SSE stream path. */
080   String STREAM_PATH = BUS_PREFIX + "/stream/{sessionId}";
081
082   /**
083    * The bus this resource serves.
084    *
085    * @return The bus.  Typically one per application, shared with the code that publishes.
086    */
087   ServerBus serverBus();
088
089   /**
090    * [POST /juneau-bus/session] &mdash; opens a bus session.
091    *
092    * <p>
093    * Body (at most 64 KB; a larger body is a 400): {@code {"v":1, "bridge":"ops", "transport":"sse"|"websocket", "downstream":[...], "upstream":[...]}}.
094    * Returns the grant ({@code sessionId}, {@code heartbeatMs}, {@code graceMs}, {@code downstream} with each topic's
095    * {@code retain}, {@code upstream} and {@code paths}).  A refusal sets its status (400, 403, 429 with
096    * {@code Retry-After}, or 501) and returns {@code {"code":..., "message":..., "denied":[...]}}.
097    *
098    * @param req The REST request.
099    * @param res The REST response.
100    * @return The grant, or the refusal body.
101    */
102   @SuppressWarnings({
103      "resource" // False positive: serverBus() returns the shared AutoCloseable bus, which this method borrows but does not own.
104   })
105   @RestPost(path=SESSION_PATH, summary="Open a message-bus session", swagger=@OpSwagger(ignore=true))
106   default JsonMap openBusSession(RestRequest req, RestResponse res) {
107      var bus = serverBus();
108      var hreq = req.getHttpServletRequest();
109      var boundary = bus.policy().boundary();
110      if (boundary != null) {
111         var r = boundary.check(hreq);
112         if (! r.isAllowed()) {
113            res.setStatus(r.status());
114            return JsonMap.of("code", "bus:refused", "message", r.message());
115         }
116      }
117      else if (bus.policy().sameOriginCheck() && ! sameOrigin(hreq)) {
118         res.setStatus(403);
119         return JsonMap.of("code", "bus:refused", "message", "Cross-origin request refused.");
120      }
121      try {
122         var session = bus.openSession(hreq, sessionBody(req));
123         return bus.grant(session, servletBase(req) + BUS_PREFIX, req.getContextPath());
124      } catch (BusRefusal e) {
125         res.setStatus(e.status());
126         e.retryAfterSeconds().ifPresent(x -> res.setHeader("Retry-After", String.valueOf(x)));
127         return e.toJson();
128      }
129   }
130
131   /**
132    * The default check applied when the policy has no boundary: a request with an {@code Origin} header passes only
133    * when that origin's scheme and authority equal the request's scheme and {@code Host}, and a {@code Sec-Fetch-Site}
134    * header, when present, is {@code same-origin}.  A request with no {@code Origin} passes (non-browser clients).
135    *
136    * @param req The servlet request.
137    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the request is allowed.
138    */
139   private static boolean sameOrigin(HttpServletRequest req) {
140      var site = req.getHeader("Sec-Fetch-Site");
141      if (site != null && neqic("same-origin", site.trim()))
142         return false;
143      var origin = req.getHeader("Origin");
144      if (origin == null)
145         return true;
146      var host = req.getHeader("Host");
147      var i = origin.indexOf("://");
148      return host != null && i > 0
149         && eqic(origin.substring(0, i), req.getScheme())
150         && eqic(origin.substring(i + 3), host);
151   }
152
153   /**
154    * [GET /juneau-bus/stream/{sessionId}] &mdash; streams the session's frames as Server-Sent Events.
155    *
156    * <p>
157    * Sends the resync, then live frames, until the client goes away or the bus closes the connection (bus closed,
158    * session expired, replaced by another connection, or too slow).  Each frame is one {@code event: bus} with the
159    * frame as {@code data} and its {@code seq}, when it has one, as {@code id}.
160    *
161    * <p>
162    * The stream URL contains the session capability, so an application must not log request URIs for
163    * {@code /juneau-bus/stream/*}.  Juneau's own debug pipeline logs the request path of every completed call when the
164    * resolved logger is loggable at {@code INFO} or finer, and {@code RestSession} logs it at {@code FINE} when a
165    * client disconnects; keep those loggers coarser than {@code INFO} for resources that serve the bus.
166    *
167    * @param id The session's capability id.
168    * @param req The REST request.
169    * @param res The REST response.
170    * @throws IOException If the stream could not be written.
171    */
172   @SuppressWarnings({
173      "resource" // False positive: serverBus() returns the shared AutoCloseable bus (not owned here) and the fluent sse.sendEvent/flush calls return the same 'sse' already managed by the try-with-resources.
174   })
175   @RestGet(path=STREAM_PATH, summary="Message-bus SSE stream", swagger=@OpSwagger(ignore=true))
176   default void streamBus(@Path("sessionId") String id, RestRequest req, RestResponse res) throws IOException {
177      var bus = serverBus();
178      var hreq = req.getHttpServletRequest();
179      var boundary = bus.policy().boundary();
180      if (boundary != null) {
181         var r = boundary.check(hreq);
182         if (! r.isAllowed()) {
183            res.setStatus(r.status());
184            return;
185         }
186      }
187      else if (bus.policy().sameOriginCheck() && ! sameOrigin(hreq)) {
188         res.setStatus(403);
189         return;
190      }
191      var session = bus.session(id, hreq.getUserPrincipal()).orElse(null);
192      if (session == null) {
193         res.setStatus(404);
194         return;
195      }
196      var wait = bus.policy().heartbeat();
197      var sink = new SseFrameSink(bus.subscribeSse(session), bus.policy().maxQueuedFrames());
198      try (var sse = res.sse()) {
199         var writer = res.getNegotiatedWriter();
200         bus.connect(session, sink);
201         BusStream.pump(sink, e -> sse.sendEvent(e).flush(), writer::checkError, wait);
202      } catch (InterruptedException e) {
203         Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
204      } finally {
205         bus.disconnect(session, sink);
206         sink.release();
207      }
208   }
209
210   /** Parses the POST body; anything but a JSON object, or a body over 64 KB, is a 400. */
211   private static JsonMap sessionBody(RestRequest req) throws BusRefusal {
212      String text;
213      try {
214         text = BusStream.readSessionBody(req.getInputStream());
215      } catch (IOException e) {
216         throw BusRefusal.badRequest("the session request could not be read");
217      }
218      try {
219         return text.isBlank() ? null : JsonMap.ofString(text, JsonParser.DEFAULT);
220      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
221         throw BusRefusal.badRequest("the session request must be a JSON object");
222      }
223   }
224
225   /** The root-relative servlet path (context plus servlet) without a trailing slash. */
226   private static String servletBase(RestRequest req) {
227      return BusStream.trimBase(req.getUriContext().getRootRelativeServletPath());
228   }
229}
